content: TypeORM InsertQueryBuilder exposes .orIgnore() (emits ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, no target support) and .orUpdate(columns, conflictTarget) for upsert. The older .onConflict(raw-sql-string) method is deprecated in favor of these two typed methods; both are present across the 0.3.x line including 0.3.31. For idempotent game_event inserts (UNIQUE(game_id,seq)) use .insert().values(...).orIgnore() -- equivalent to ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
